cards.front: Monitoring vs observability for AI apps?
cards.back: Track latency, cost, errors, quality proxies, and slice regressions—not only uptime.
Coordinate retrieval, model calls, tools, guardrails, and human steps—often DAG/workflow engines.
Swap models, retrievers, or policies without rewriting the whole product—eval each module.
Post-model filters for policy, PII, toxicity—latency cost but catches failures prompts miss.
Copy button, dwell time, regenerate clicks, accepted edits—often richer than explicit thumbs alone.
